item.title: Getting started with Speedle Cloud
item.description: Sign in, save a policy, create an API key, and check authorization from your application.

item.title: Speedle Cloud API keys
item.description: API keys belong to your account and can access its services according to their scope. They authenticate your application, not its end users. Managing API keys, sessions and linked identities always requires a signed-in console session. Speedle Cloud is in public beta. This guide describes the workflow for the live service. Create an API key Open API keys, enter a name of 1–128 characters after trimming whitespace, select a scope and an expiry (7d, 30d, 90d, 180d or 365d; the console defaults to 3 months), and choose Create.

item.title: Speedle Cloud Limits and errors
item.description: Speedle Cloud is in public beta. This guide describes the workflow for the live service. Limits apply to the whole account unless a row says otherwise. API keys are account credentials; changing keys does not increase the daily quota. Limits What is limited Limit When reached / how to recover Services per account 100 409 quota_exceeded; delete an unused service. No timed reset.
